title: drosera macrantha subsp. planchonii
intro: Drosera macrantha subsp. planchonii, commonly known as a species of carnivorous plant, is a type of sundew that obtains essential nutrients by capturing and digesting insects. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation and reduce stress, attributed to its health benefits in treating anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Drosera macrantha subsp. planchonii include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its calming effects on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
